stem_book: A uniform circular arc is placed with its centre of curvature at the origin, symmetric about the x-axis. Where does its centre of mass lie, based on symmetry? (a) At the center (b) Along y-axis (c) Along x-axis (d) Outside the arc
reason: Ambiguous: print gives no arc orientation (x-axis only by convention), and (d) 'Outside the arc' is also true since the COM at 2R sin(φ/2)/φ < R lies off the arc material
work: COM on symmetry axis at r = 2R sin(φ/2)/φ < R ⇒ on x-axis (if arc symmetric about x) and not on the arc
